name: alaya-database
description: Local Alaya memory for Codex: recall project knowledge and save confirmed notes through a stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Recall and save local Alaya memories
interface.longDescription: Alaya Database keeps memories in one local SQLite file. This plugin starts the bundled stdio MCP server so Codex can search existing memories, read a knowledge group's full text, and save a confirmed conclusion into a chosen group. Nothing leaves the machine; the same file is shared with the Alaya desktop app, the CLI and the DSH plugin.
